interface.name: unbound_shell_v1

description.summary: requests and events between the compositor and the shell

interface.description: Offered only on the connections of the shell clients the compositor starts itself (the Dock and the launcher), never on the listening socket.

request.name: activate_app

description.summary: bring an app forward

request.description: Focuses and raises the frontmost window of the app with this app id and raises its other windows behind it, as clicking a running app in the Dock does. Ignored when the app has no mapped window.

description.summary: the user pressed the launcher shortcut

event.name: capture_screen

description.summary: the user pressed the full-screen capture shortcut

event.description: Sent for Super+Shift+3, as Command-Shift-3 takes a picture of the whole screen on a Mac.

event.name: capture_area

description.summary: the user pressed the area capture shortcut

event.description: Sent for Super+Shift+4, as Command-Shift-4 lets the user drag out the part of the screen to take a picture of on a Mac.

event.name: active_app

description.summary: the app of the key window changed

event.description: Sent on binding and whenever the window with keyboard focus changes to one of another app, with that app's app id, as the macOS menu bar names the active app. An empty app id means no window has the keyboard, as when the user clicks the empty desktop.

event.name: volume_key

description.summary: the user pressed a volume key

event.description: Sent for the mute, volume down and volume up keys, with or without Super and also while the session is locked, as a Mac's volume keys always work. Fine is 1 when Option and Shift are held, which on a Mac changes the volume in quarter steps.

request.name: toggle_control_center

description.summary: open or close Control Center

request.description: Sent by the menu bar when its Control Center item is clicked. The compositor relays it to every shell client as toggle_control_center.

description.summary: the user asked to open or close Control Center

request.name: set_icon_rect

description.summary: say where an app's icon is shown

request.description: Tells the compositor where the Dock shows the icon of the app with this app id, as a rectangle in the surface coordinates of the given surface. The compositor minimises the app's windows into this rectangle and restores them out of it. A width or height of 0 forgets the rectangle, as when the icon leaves the Dock. The rectangle is also forgotten when the surface is destroyed.

event.name: app_responding

description.summary: an app stopped or started answering

event.description: The compositor pings an app through xdg_wm_base whenever the user interacts with one of its windows, and every app with a window when Force Quit is opened. Sent with responding 0 when an app has not answered for 3 seconds, and with responding 1 when it answers again or exits. Also sent on binding for every app that is not responding, so Force Quit can mark it. Pid is the process on the other end of the app's connection, app id the app id of its windows.

request.name: hide_app

description.summary: hide every window of an app

request.description: Fades out every window of the app with this app id, as Hide in a Mac's Dock menu or Command-H does. The windows take no input while hidden. activate_app, activate_window or an activation request from the app shows them again.

request.name: quit_app

description.summary: ask an app to quit

request.description: Asks the app with this app id to quit, as Super+Q does: through unbound_app_v1.quit_requested when the app has bound it, otherwise by asking each of its windows to close. The app may ask the user first.

request.name: force_quit_app

description.summary: end an app at once

request.description: Kills every process on the other end of a connection with a window of the app with this app id, without asking. Shell clients are never killed.

request.name: activate_window

description.summary: bring one window forward

request.description: Shows, restores if minimised, raises and focuses the window whose ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 identifier is given, as picking a window from a Dock icon's menu does. The Dock lists the windows, their titles and app ids through ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1.

event.name: window_minimized

description.summary: a window was minimised or restored

event.description: Sent whenever the window with this ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 identifier is minimised (1) or restored (0), and on binding for every minimised window, so the Dock icon menu can mark minimised windows.

event.name: attention_requested

description.summary: an app wants the user's attention

event.description: Sent when an app asks to be activated without a valid activation token, for example when it finishes work in the background. The compositor does not raise it; the Dock bounces its icon instead.

request.name: set_corner_radius

description.summary: round the background effect of a surface

request.description: Rounds each blur region the surface set through ext_background_effect_surface_v1 with this radius, in surface coordinates, so a rounded Dock or menu blurs exactly behind its shape. 0 means square corners, the default.

event.name: focus_shell

description.summary: the user asked to reach a shell element from the keyboard

event.description: Sent with the layer namespace "dock" for Super+F3 and "menubar" for Super+F2, after the compositor gave that layer surface the keyboard. The client shows its keyboard selection. To give the keyboard back, for example on Escape, it calls activate_app with the active app.

request.name: show_app

description.summary: show the hidden windows of an app

request.description: Fades the windows of the app with this app id back in after hide_app, without raising them or moving the keyboard focus, as Show All in a Mac's app menu does.

event.name: brightness_key

description.summary: the user pressed a brightness key

event.description: Sent for the display and keyboard brightness keys, with or without Super and also while the session is locked, as volume_key is. Fine is 1 when Option and Shift are held, for quarter steps.

interface.name: unbound_app_v1

description.summary: requests from the desktop to a whole app

interface.description: Offered to every client. A client that binds it takes over app-level requests that the compositor would otherwise express per window: while it is bound, the compositor sends quit_requested instead of closing each of the client's toplevels.

event.name: quit_requested

description.summary: the user asked to quit the app

event.description: Sent for Super+Q, as Command-Q quits an app on a Mac. The app should quit: close all its windows and exit, asking the user once first if something would be lost, as a terminal with running programs does. If the user cancels, the app keeps running and nothing is closed.

entry.name: left
entry.summary: the left half of the usable area

entry.name: restore
entry.summary: the size and place the window had before it was tiled or zoomed

request.name: place_window

description.summary: tile one of the app's windows

request.description: Places the toplevel as the window menu's Move and Resize items do, with the same animation and tiled states as dragging the window to a screen edge or pressing Ctrl+Super+Arrows. Restore undoes tiling and zoom. Zoom, full screen and minimise use xdg_toplevel's own requests. Ignored for a toplevel of another client and in full screen.
